description: Files travel as raw bytes. Toolbox's spec is Swagger 2.0: POST /files/upload-v2 takes the file as a formData part (or, per its description, a raw application/octet-stream body), which the converter drops, so uploadFile had no content member; GET /files/download returns `type: file`, which the converter types as a JSON Document. Send the upload as the raw body and decode the download as bytes.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: File contents, sent verbatim as the request body.
